images.caption: Figure 1:Spectral channels carry spatially distinct physical information.On a Painted Bunting (a), the red belly, green back, and blue head each align with a different RGB channel; on a Sentinel-2 scene (b), water, forest, and built-up areas align with B3, B8A, and B12. SSI is designed to recover this joint spectral-spatial structure.

Figure 4:Qualitative examples of spectral-spatial attribution.Representative CUB-200, HLS Burn Scar, and EuroSAT examples showing
channel-aggregated maps and selected channel-level attributions. SSI illustrates
localized channel evidence that is not captured by a single heatmap or a global
channel ranking.
